description: This file provides support for executing JavaScript within a WKWebView, including applying debug status and evaluating JavaScript to strings. It encapsulates JavaScript injection and safe evaluation logic, facilitating interaction between Swift and web content.

methods.name: applyDebugStatus
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into a WKWebView to set debug status and optionally update status labels via a JavaScript API.

methods.name: evaluateToString
methods.description: Asynchronously evaluates JavaScript code in a WKWebView and returns the result as a String.

methods.name: jsValue
methods.description: Encodes an optional String as a JSON-compatible JavaScript value literal, handling nulls.
